purpose: Make an outcome-disciplined architecture decision after the local exact-quadratic-preserving metric/operator escape audits and the source-locked compensator audit, without fitting a new field or symmetry to cancel the already-observed soft-s obstruction.

frozen_options.AD_HOC_NEW_COMPENSATOR: Introduce a new compensator/spurion or spatial-conformal symmetry specifically to cancel the current soft-s obstruction.
frozen_options.REJECT_MINIMAL_BRANCH_PENDING_INDEPENDEN: Do not tune a new compensator to the obstruction. Record the minimal nonlinear branch as rejected at this scoped cubic test, keep k=0.03 production blocked, and require any enlarged completion to be independently specified and to restart background/quadratic/DOF certification before re-testing the soft channel.

frozen_decision_rule: If s6fP shows the tested local metric-only/mixed-operator exact-off-shell-quadratic-preserving escape class cannot alter the soft response, and s6fQ finds no source-locked compensator/spurion law, select REJECT_MINIMAL_BRANCH_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_NEW_COMPLETION. AD_HOC_NEW_COMPENSATOR is forbidden because it would fit new nonlinear structure to a known failed observable rather than derive it independently.
required_guards: no new field, coefficient, Weyl weight, or symmetry law introduced
minimal-branch rejection is explicitly scoped and not an RTK-wide no-go
forbidden: choosing a compensator coupling after seeing the soft-s result
calling the result a no-go for RTK as a whole
claiming radiative naturalness or same-full-action closure
nonclaims: not a theorem excluding extra-field UV completions
not a theorem excluding nonlocal completions
not a theorem excluding a new independently motivated symmetry
